name: Mauria Udyog Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1980, Mauria Udyog Ltd is in the business of manufacturing and trading 
of LPG cylinders and related accessories[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
a) MUL is the flagship entity of the Mauria Group.
b) Core operations: manufacturing LPG cylinders, valves, regulators, disposable & refillable cylinders for LPG, ammonia, and refrigerants.
c) Produces 100% cotton terry towels under Eurospa, sold domestically and exported (Ukraine, France).
d) Additional activities:
- Trading/manufacturing agro-commodities (soybean meal & cake).
- Domestic trading of metals (steel, brass, copper, ferrous scrap).

pros: Company is expected to give good quarter
cons: Stock is trading at 3.24 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.87%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Earnings include an other income of Rs.12.7 Cr.
